artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan implementing the research ruling (Option 1): a fourth local, non-declared file_scope_arr splice in git-commit-phase.sh admitting a touched extension's own manifest.json, pinned by six new fixtures and documented in git-staging-scope.md.

memory_candidates.content: A plan phase whose Tier Justification claims a narrowed verification pass must name the suites that `suite_selection_select` actually returns for that phase's whole Files-to-modify set, run as ONE multi-path invocation. The selector is sourceable directly at authoring time (`source agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh; suite_selection_select PATH...`), which is cheaper and more honest than running verify-touched.sh (which has no dry-run/print-suites flag and would execute the whole narrowed battery just to learn the suite names).
